partial_operation: valueOrZero totalizes a native arithmetic error to zero solely outside the specified partial domain. Assisted correspondence derives .ok for every native operation on valid inputs. Negative Nat values, oversized Word values and accounts outside Fin 3 are unrepresentable; Examples proves representation completeness and exclusions. No invalid transition behavior is claimed.

New proof helpers are compiled during every assisted replay and counted once by shared-helper inventory. P3 instantiates a general symbolic-list theorem at exact lengths 4 and 16.
sequence: General list theorem, arbitrary independent instruction objects, validity at each actual intermediate native-arithmetic state. Generic induction is recorded explicitly; length scaling is instantiation rather than unrolling.

Independent leanchecker kernel replays every newly authored model/procedure/helper/target module from existing olean artifacts; pinned imported libraries remain trusted, not --fresh. This checker uses the same Lean kernel and is not an independent implementation.

reconstruction: Offline SHA256-locked official Lean archive and pinned upstream source/dependency cache. Fresh adapter, HOME, cache and extracted runtime. Host OS shared; not an OS/security sandbox. No network needed.

artifacts: Distinct Lean compiled .olean module parts include proof terms; sizes/hashes retained by harness. They are not tool logs or a portable standalone proof certificate.
source_accounting: Reviewed Lean lexical code lines and Python ast/tokenize; native Lean command-parser supplemental inventory contains recovery errors explicitly. Generated files match retained templates. Infrastructure/admission checks and the unrelated selection example are excluded from benchmark counts.
